name: pulse
context_rationale: Read-only vault summarization from files on disk; all required state is in vault files and git state, no main-thread conversation context needed.
summary: Scans the AI SDLC vault and produces a compact macro-state summary covering active slice stage, risk exposure, regression health, Critic calibration status, top lessons, and recommended next action. Read-only — never modifies vault files. Dispatches summary text rendering to a Haiku subagent for cost efficiency. Supports three modes: default, --brief, and --full.

reads.purpose: Mode, classification, pipeline path, deferred steps
Open risks with status and score for Risk exposure section
Active slice list and recent-10 slices
Active slice stage, next-action, progress checkboxes, on-resume data
Last 15 lines of Events section when stage is build or later
Count of critical paths and last full catalog run
Last calibration run date and slices since last run for CAL-1 cadence enforcement
Last 3-5 most recent lessons for Top lessons section
Unresolved drift count for Drift and bypass section
Surface the live candidate backlog (counts, top-priority, blocked-on-spike) in the macro-state summary.

tools.name: pulse_worktree_resolver
tools.purpose: Enumerate non-main worktrees on slice/* branches for BRANCH-2 worktree detection

tools.name: risk_register_audit
tools.purpose: Produce scored, sorted output of open risks for the Risk exposure section

tools.name: stranded_slice_audit
tools.purpose: Classify unmerged slice/* branches without worktrees into 4-class divergence model

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read vault files: triage.json, concept.json, risk-register.json, slices/_index.json, action-points.json, active slice milestone.json, build-log.json tail, shippability.json, critic-calibration-log.json, lessons-learned.json, drift-log.json

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run git worktree list --porcelain for BRANCH-2 worktree detection

harness_tools.name: Agent
harness_tools.purpose: Dispatch to Haiku subagent for summary text rendering
